question: The derived unit for electrical conductance, the Siemens (S), can be expressed in terms of SI base units as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __kg⁻¹ m⁻² s³ A²__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Siemens (S) is the derived SI unit for electrical conductance.
 
• It is reciprocal to the unit of resistance, which is Ohm (Ω).
 
• The unit Siemens can be expressed in base SI units as kg⁻¹ m⁻² s³ A².
